description_en: Performs drift detection on resources in a stack to determine whether the resources have drifted from the expected configurations
description_zh: 对资源进行偏差检测，以便确定资源是否已偏离其预期的模板配置
kebab_example: aliyun ros detect-stack-resource-drift --stack-id 4a6c9851-3b0f-4f5f-b4ca-a14bf6910000 --client-token 123e4567-e89b-12d3-a456-426655440000 --biz-region-id cn-hangzhou --logical-resource-id ScalingRuleName --region cn-hangzhou
name: DetectStackResourceDrift

parameters.help_en:
The client token that is used to ensure the idempotence of the request. You can use the client to generate the value, but you must ensure that it is unique among different requests.

The value can be up to 64 characters in length and can contain letters, digits, hyphens (-), and underscores (_).

For more information, see https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/134212.html
parameters.help_zh:
保证请求的幂等性。 该值由客户端生成，并且必须是全局唯一的。   
长度最大为64个字符，可包含英文字符、数字、短划线（-）和下划线（_）。  
更多详情，请参见https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/134212.html
parameters.name: client_token

parameters.help_en: The region ID of the stack. You can call the https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/131035.html operation to query the most recent region list
parameters.help_zh: 资源栈所属的地域ID。您可以调用https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/131035.html查看最新的阿里云地域列表
parameters.name: region_id

ActualProperties.description_zh: 实际的资源属性，以JSON格式表示

DriftDetectionTime.description_en: The time when the resource drift detection was initiated

ExpectedProperties.description_en: The JSON-formatted resource properties that are defined in the template
ExpectedProperties.description_zh: 模板中定义的资源属性，以JSON格式表示

LogicalResourceId.description_en: The logical ID of the resource that is defined in the template
LogicalResourceId.description_zh: 资源逻辑ID，即模板中资源的名称

PhysicalResourceId.description_en: The physical ID of the resource

PropertyDifferences.description_en: The property drifts of the resource

ActualValue.description_en: The actual value of the resource property

DifferenceType.description_en:
The drift type of the resource property. Valid values:

ADD: The property value has been added to a resource property whose data type was Array or List.

REMOVE: The property has been deleted from the current resource configuration.

NOT_EQUAL: The current property value differs from the expected value defined in the stack template
DifferenceType.description_zh:
资源属性的偏差类型。取值：
ADD：已将值添加到数据类型为数组或列表的资源属性。
REMOVE：属性已从当前资源配置中删除。
NOT_EQUAL：当前属性值与资源栈模板中定义的预期值不同

ExpectedValue.description_en: The expected value of the resource property that is defined in the template

PropertyPath.description_en: The path of the resource property

ResourceDriftStatus.description_en:
The drift status of the resource. Valid values:

DELETED: The actual configuration of the resource differs from its expected template configuration because the resource is deleted.

MODIFIED: The actual configuration of the resource differs from its expected template configuration.

NOT_CHECKED: Resource Orchestration Service (ROS) has not checked whether the actual configuration of the resource differs from its expected template configuration.

IN_SYNC: The actual configuration of the resource matches its expected template configuration
ResourceDriftStatus.description_zh:
资源偏差状态。取值：
DELETED：资源与预期的模板配置不同，因为资源已被删除。
MODIFIED：资源与预期的模板配置不同。
NOT_CHECKED：ROS未检查资源与预期的模板配置是否不同。
IN_SYNC：资源的当前配置与其预期的模板配置相匹配
